(BY SHRI S. K. GUPTA - PANEL LAWYER )
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the third application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.67/2021 dated 20.2.2021, registered at Police Station - Chandrameta,
District Chhindwara for the offence under Sections 498A, 304B, 34 of IPC.

Applicant's first bail application and second bail application were dismissed on merits by order dated 25.1.2021 passed in M.Cr.C.No.37596/2021 and order dated 1.12.2022 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.2659/2022.

As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this third bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant - Sani Shamsher too is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Sani Shamsher vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72762964/
